question: With which country did India conduct the joint Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) exercise in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Maldives**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The joint **Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR)** exercise between India and **The Maldives** was successfully conducted in **May 2025** to enhance collaborative efforts in crisis management.
 
• The exercise aimed to strengthen the interoperability and functional coordination between the **Indian Navy**, the **Indian Coast Guard**, and the **Maldives National Defence Force (MNDF)**.
 
• This engagement is a significant component of India’s **SAGAR** (**Security and Growth for All in the Region**) vision, which focuses on cooperative security and capacity building in the **Indian Ocean Region (IOR)**.
 
• During the drills, both nations practiced **Search and Rescue (SAR)** operations, **medical evacuations** (MEDEVAC), and the rapid deployment of **relief materials** to simulate responses to natural calamities like cyclones and tsunamis.
